truth_evidence: Affected every release before 3.15; fixed in 3.15 (inputs that bypass the CVE-2024-3651 fix: callers of alabel/ulabel/check_label and the incremental codec had no length cap, so validation is still quadratic).

The advisory links no commit. The fix is e1cb465 'Enforce early length limits in check_label' (PR #230), in tag v3.15 and not in v3.14; its comment cites GHSA-65pc-fj4g-8rjx. https://github.com/kjd/idna/commit/e1cb465b6376f33306a26f467d197edbcd01c4b9
check_label: after the empty-label check, raises IDNAError('Label too long') when valid_string_length(label, trailing_dot=True) is false, before any per-code-point validation.
Entry points: as for GHSA-jjg7-2v4v-x38h; valid_contextj is unchanged here and not listed.
notes: Between v3.14 and v3.15 the commits 9d86ba6, ab7d46c and c18b804 also touch idna/core.py (lint and tidy refactors). None is the fix. Relevant for phase B.
